stem.en: Kabir says "the wheel makes lots of ATP, it is the powerhouse". Per glucose, how many coins has the wheel made directly?

text.en: Two, one per acetyl. The wheel's real product is full carriers: ten NADH and two others per glucose. The coins come later, from emptying them.

feedback.en: The powerhouse has three parts. The wheel is the middle one, and it mostly fills buckets.

text.en: None; the wheel only makes gas.

feedback.en: It makes one coin per turn, and it breathes out two carbons per turn, and it fills four carriers per turn. All three.
An NADH is not a coin. It is a full bucket, worth about two and a half coins once emptied on the staircase.

explanation.en: Keep coins and buckets separate. The wheel fills buckets. The next lesson empties them, and that is where the count goes from four to thirty.
